milestone.description: One authored bossfight milestone: the 3 upgrade cards it offers and the love it pays out when that bossfight is LOST.

retaliation_bonus_love.description: Love paid to the player (RunState.add_love) when THIS milestone's bossfight is lost - the retaliation reward, and its sole source of truth (D7; replaces enemies.json's Boss loss_love_reward). Paid on a loss only; a win pays nothing. 0 = no payout.

slots.description: Exactly 3 direct-assigned upgrade cards (D2 - always 3 shown, never randomized). Each entry is a Catalog key or null for an empty, still-persisted slot. An upgrade id may appear in at most ONE slot across the whole timeline (D3) - an authoring-time constraint JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by the editor's validate_uniqueness.

upgrade_ref.description: A BossUpgrades.Catalog key, or null for an empty slot. The enum is the closed set of 12 upgrades - each needs bespoke code, so a new id is a schema change, never a content one.

description: Boss upgrade timeline balancing domain (BossUpgradeTimelinePLAN D8): the 12 boss upgrades a player may be offered after a bossfight, plus the 4 authored milestones that decide which 3 are offered and how much retaliation love a LOST bossfight pays. Catalog is a CLOSED set of 12 fixed named keys (each one needs bespoke game code, so it is not an open array); a designer edits each upgrade's name, description and numeric params, never the roster. Milestones cycle every 4th bossfight: milestone_index = (boss_num - 1) % 4 (D1), so boss 5 re-offers milestone 1's identical 3 options. Bounds policy: percentages are whole-number 0-100 ints (never 0-1 fractions), seconds 0-60, love/counts 0-10000, rounds/levels 0-1000 - the repo's standard per-kind ranges.

BossUpgrades.description: The whole boss-upgrade feature: the fixed upgrade catalog and the authored 4-milestone timeline over it.

Catalog.description: The 12 boss upgrades, keyed by their permanent upgrade id (the id the game's effect engine and the timeline slots both reference). Closed set: additionalProperties false and all 12 required.

extra_triggers.description: Extra apply_per_turn() calls every boost building makes inside payday's existing slot-7 boost step (1 = it triggers twice in total). A permanent global rule - boost buildings placed before AND after the pick are affected (D18).
